criteria: Declines first-, second- and third-declension nouns accurately in all cases
States or recognises fourth- and fifth-declension nouns from their genitive singular
Agrees adjectives correctly by gender/number/case even across different declension patterns
Forms comparatives and superlatives accurately, including the irregular forms
Recognises the required pronouns and pronominal adjectives from the defined vocabulary list
L01_Nouns_Adjectives_Pronouns.pass_threshold: Secure, accurate declining of first-, second- and third-declension nouns and regular adjectives is required to pass; recognition of fourth/fifth declensions and pronouns should be reliable, allowing occasional slips under exam pressure.

Recognises and translates the required forms of sum, possum, eo, fero, volo and nolo
